title: Operationalize LibreFS and S3-compatible storage

context.summary: Make LibreFS and external S3-compatible storage usable from installer and Compose flows.
context.background: TASK-56 added the S3-compatible object storage adapter and smoke coverage, while later installer tasks added storage choices and single-home Compose assets. TASK-82 closes the operational gap by bootstrapping local buckets, validating external bucket access and documenting the supported S3 paths.

in: Add bucket-level ensure and access-check operations to the S3-compatible storage adapter.
Add LibreFS and MinIO bucket bootstrap services to Docker Compose with health-gated startup.
Add installer validation for S3 endpoint, bucket and credentials.
Add an installer bootstrap-storage step that runs local bucket bootstrap or validates external S3-compatible access.
Cover LibreFS profile startup and external S3 signed bucket checks in installer/storage validators.
Update configuration, deployment, installer and public support documentation.
out: Remote bucket deletion during rollback or uninstall.
Full upstream LibreFS behavior certification beyond the S3-compatible local profile.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/storage-s3 can ensure a bucket exists and verify bucket access using signed requests.
Docker Compose provides health-gated LibreFS and MinIO bucket bootstrap services.
Installer plans include a bootstrap-storage step after infrastructure startup and before migrations.
Installer startup runs the LibreFS or MinIO bucket bootstrap service for local S3 profiles.
Installer startup validates and signs bucket access for external S3-compatible endpoints.
.env.example and docs describe the supported LibreFS/external S3 operational path.

manual_checks: Confirm local-fs remains the default storage provider.
Confirm installer rollback does not attempt to delete external S3 buckets.

risks: Bucket bootstrap must not run against external endpoints unless explicitly selected through S3 validation.
Compose health checks must remain compatible with LibreFS/MinIO local profiles.
Installer diagnostics must surface credential or bucket failures clearly.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
